verification: manifest is strict JSON with exactly the required fields
library_path and model_archive_path are caller-owned absolute paths
SHA-256 of both files matches the manifest
source_commit equals the pinned Xiph revision
sample rate, channels and frame size equal 48 kHz mono 480-sample geometry
no download, copy, build, load or execution occurs in this package

exact_blockers: The exact RNNoise v0.2 source, model archive and model_version are pinned by SHA-256 from the external Xiph checkout, but the compiled runtime library expected at data/envs/rnnoise/librnnoise.dylib is absent and no caller-supplied asset manifest is present in this SDK worktree; the exact runtime cannot be loaded or reproduced here.

The upstream RNNoise source is BSD-3-Clause, but separate pretrained model/archive terms, product-use and redistribution rights, and training-data provenance are not established; no legal review exists. No asset was downloaded, copied, built, vendored or redistributed.

Only a deterministic model-free boundary surrogate was executed. It is not RNNoise, has no neural network or weights, and its paired synthetic SI-SDR/STOI values are boundary-conformance observations, not a quality, real-audio, listening, device-timing or benchmark result.

No rights-cleared real cohort, independent listening, target-runtime timing/memory, native streaming integration, opt-in provider intake, descriptor/registry review or public default decision exists; every release gate remains blocked.
